account_sync_rule: claude.ai account-synced skills are enumerable only from a host snapshot. Without a snapshot the ACCOUNT_SYNC source is SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED / INCOMPLETE.
additional_directories_rule: additionalDirectories from any settings layer adds <dir>/.claude/skills as an ADD_DIR root (required). A listed directory that is missing or unreadable is SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED (scope ADD_DIR, INCOMPLETE).

disable_mechanisms.false_means: the plugin's skills are disabled in every root the entry covers
disable_mechanisms.note: Documented Claude Code settings key. A bare plugin name (no @marketplace) is the adapter's name-based reading: it disables the plugin from every marketplace that provides it.

disable_mechanisms.false_means: every instance whose logical name matches is disabled
disable_mechanisms.note: A namespaced override ("acme:deploy") never touches the bare skill ("deploy") and vice versa. Matching more than one instance is NAME_SELECTOR_BLAST_RADIUS.
disable_mechanisms.scope: all roots; name-based only, no path selector (PROJECT_BOOK §4.4)

extra_plugin_dir_conflict_rule: A plugin disabled by enabledPlugins in registered roots but still loadable (ELIGIBLE) from an unregistered extra plugin directory is DISABLE_MISMATCH (P1, FAIL): the disable mapping and the extra directory disagree about whether the skill loads. skillOverrides-based disables cover every root by construction, so they cannot produce this conflict.
known_but_not_enforced: disableSideloadFlags (managed setting that can refuse --plugin-dir; the adapter does not enforce it yet)
prependPlugins / appendPlugins (plugin load order; not a scope question)
pluginConfigs (per-plugin configuration; not a scope question)

marketplace_rules.default_plugin_dir: The default plugin directory is <home>/.claude/plugins. Plugin directories are discovered as <plugins>/marketplaces/<marketplace>/<plugin> and as flat <plugins>/<plugin>. A missing default plugin directory means no user plugins: it is not an error.
marketplace_rules.extraKnownMarketplaces_directory: A directory-source marketplace entry ({name, path} or {name, source: {type: "directory", path}}) is enumerated as plugin roots: <marketplace>/<plugin>/skills when present, else <marketplace>/<plugin>.
marketplace_rules.extraKnownMarketplaces_git: A git-source marketplace entry ({name, source: {type: "git", url}}) cannot be fetched offline; its plugins are unenumerated (SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED, scope PLUGIN, INCOMPLETE), never silently ignored.
marketplace_rules.missing_declared_marketplace: A declared marketplace directory that is missing or unreadable is SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED (scope PLUGIN, INCOMPLETE).
marketplace_rules.strictKnownMarketplaces: When the managed layer sets strictKnownMarketplaces to true, plugin roots from marketplaces that are not registered in settings are refused by the host: their skills are DISCOVERED (not loadable), never ELIGIBLE, so no DISABLE_MISMATCH arises from them. Only the managed layer's value is honoured.

namespace_rule: Plugin skills carry the namespace in their logical name (<plugin>:<name>) and are never merged with bare local skills of the same base name. Two instances <plugin>:<name> and <name> are two instances.

local.note: Local project settings; not committed. Lowest precedence.

managed.note: Enterprise managed settings. Highest precedence; cannot be overridden. The adapter takes an explicit path only and never defaults to a machine path, so a test never reads a real machine's managed settings.

project.note: Shared project settings; committed with the repository.

user.note: Personal preferences; applies to every project on the machine.

settings_unreadable_rule: A settings layer file that is present but unreadable, invalid JSON, or invalid in shape makes that layer's effect unknowable: INCOMPLETE with an unknown scope named after the layer (MANAGED_SETTINGS / USER_SETTINGS / PROJECT_SETTINGS / LOCAL_SETTINGS). A missing layer file is not an error.

trust_rule: additionalDirectories and extraKnownMarketplaces apply only after the folder is trusted. When the audit input says trusted is false, skills from settings-derived ADD_DIR and marketplace roots are DISCOVERED (the host will not load them until trust), never ELIGIBLE. Explicit --plugin-dir style extra plugin directories and caller-provided source roots are not trust-gated.
user_override_rule: The USER layer overrides PROJECT/LOCAL for the same key. A USER-layer disable of a skill the PROJECT layer would otherwise load is applied (instance DISABLED) and recorded in diagnostics.overriddenByUser; it is deterministic, not INCOMPLETE. INCOMPLETE arises only when the USER layer file itself cannot be read or when its override targets a plugin whose marketplace root was not enumerated.
